clock: same Time.get_ticks_usec as original M1 physics/process/presentation anchors
overhead: Complete map method intervals include inserted branch/AStar observer overhead; AStar intervals include boundary calls and are nested subsets, never additive to parent methods. Both modes keep same counters/scopes/anchor clocks; clockless disables only method/AStar duration clocks. No estimated subtraction.
scope: Only Unit._do_chase direct repath strict call and its immediate ranged fallback. Other orders, exit transitions and _follow_path watchdog calls excluded.
